subject: Skill sprint: implementation drop-ins + recordings (proposed schedule)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightleaf.health>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Skill sprint: implementation drop-ins + recordings (proposed schedule)

Hi Samira — looping in Marissa and Laura from our CS and Implementation teams. Thanks again for the commitment — excited to get BrightLeaf across the finish line.

Quick proposal to make the handoff practical: a 3-session "skill sprint" series this week that mixes a short walkthrough + 30-minute live drop-in lab where your engineers can hit the sandbox and we can triage environment issues live. We'll record everything and share the clips.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 6/16 10:00–11:00 — quick walk + lab (auth, token routing)
- Thu 6/17 14:00–15:00 — model pinning & latency tuning lab
- Fri 6/18 09:00–09:45 — final checklist + Q&A (recorded)

Attached: skill-sprint-agenda.pdf (high level), env-checklist.csv (minimal checks we need before the lab).

Marissa / Laura: can you confirm facilitators and whether we should add a separate "on-call" channel for live triage during the labs? Samira — are these windows workable for your team? If not, tell us preferred times and we’ll adapt.

Next steps:
- Confirm attendees and target sandboxes by EOD Tue 6/15
- Run env-checklist against staging keys (implement@brightleaf.health)

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-6243

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightleaf.health>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skill sprint: implementation drop-ins + recordings (proposed schedule)

Thanks Vivek — happy to run the sessions. 

I can run Wed 6/16 (auth + token routing) and Fri 6/18 (checklist + Q&A). Laura can cover Thu 6/17 for model pinning and perf tuning.

I agree on an on-call channel — propose a short-lived Slack channel (#brightleaf-oncall-6-16) and a shared Google doc to capture action items during the lab. I'll create both and post links by tomorrow morning.

Samira — a couple things we need to confirm before the first lab:
- One staging API key for the team (scoped to sandbox) and a list of 2-3 engineers who will join the hands-on lab.
- Are you able to allow outbound ports 443 and 22 from staging to our sandbox? The env-checklist calls this out but we'll help if anything blocks.

I've attached the agenda and a one-page facilitator checklist to the Slack doc (will add link). If anyone needs deeper security artifacts (SOC2, data handling), we can loop Legal/Security but want to keep the sprint focused on practical setup.

Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0122

From: Samira Khan <samira@brightleaf.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skill sprint: implementation drop-ins + recordings (proposed schedule)

Hi all — thanks for the quick plan. The proposed windows mostly work: Wed morning and Thu afternoon are fine; Fri morning conflicts with our leadership standup. Could we move the final Q&A to Fri 11:00–11:45 PT instead?

Attendees from BrightLeaf: myself (product), Ben Ortiz (platform lead), Priya Desai (SRE). We'll provision one staging API key and confirm the engineer list by EOD today.

A couple of items to flag so the lab is productive:
- Our legal team will likely ask for a short SOC2 summary; best if you can point them to the standard compliance pack.
- We have a small VPC setup in AWS; outbound to Redwood's sandbox is allowed but we may need to open a CIDR range for a short window. Priya will coordinate.

If you can share the recordings and short clips after each lab, that would be very helpful for the broader BrightLeaf team.

Samira
Senior Product Manager | BrightLeaf Health
samira@brightleaf.health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightleaf.health>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skill sprint: implementation drop-ins + recordings (proposed schedule)

Samira — updated: final Q&A moved to Fri 11:00–11:45 PT and Slack channel created: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C0BRIGHTLEAF (invite sent).

I've uploaded the agenda and env-checklist here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-Redwood-BrightLeaf-onboarding (permission: brightleaf.health). Recording from Wed's session will be posted to the same folder within 24 hours; file will be recording-20270614.mp4.

For SOC2 & compliance pack, please share the contact at your Legal team and I will route the standard pack (SOC2 summary, data retention, encryption notes). That keeps the sprint lightweight for engineers.

Action items:
- BrightLeaf: confirm the two engineers for the lab + staging API key by EOD Tue (Samira / Priya)
- Redwood: finalize Slack invite, post facilitator checklist, and push the recording after Wed lab

See you Wednesday — Marissa and Laura will send calendar invites with dial-in and sandbox links shortly.

Thanks — Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
